description: Result payload for gc pack diff: the classified capability-surface change between two pack directories.

schema_version.description: Version of this command result schema.

ok.description: Whether both manifests were computed and compared. The verdict, not ok, carries compatibility.

a.description: Older pack directory, as given on the command line.

b.description: Newer pack directory, as given on the command line.

verdict.description: Overall classification of the change from a to b: the highest that applies, in precedence order BREAKING > UNCLASSIFIED > ADDITIVE > NONE.

exit_code.description: Process exit status for the verdict: 2 BREAKING, 1 UNCLASSIFIED, 0 ADDITIVE or NONE.

items.description: Values of one property that were added or removed, and how that change is classified.

property.description: Capability property the values belong to.

change.description: Whether the values appear only in b (added) or only in a (removed).

moved_files.description: Pack-relative files whose digest changed, appeared, or disappeared, sorted, leaving out files added or removed together with the PROVIDES value they belong to. Non-empty means the verdict is at least UNCLASSIFIED.
